questions.stem:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.

a. Minh: Yes. Scientists say it's mainly caused by global warming.
b. Hoa: Have you heard that this summer was one of the hottest on record?
c. Hoa: So what can students like us do to help?
d. Minh: We can save energy and use public transport more often.
e. Hoa: Good idea. Let's start by cycling to school.
questions.explanation: Hoa mở đầu câu chuyện (b) → Minh xác nhận, nêu nguyên nhân (a) → Hoa hỏi cách giúp (c) → Minh gợi ý (d) → Hoa đồng ý (e).

questions.stem:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.

a. It was founded in 1967 by five countries: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand.
b. The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is a regional organisation.
c. Viet Nam joined the association in 1995.
d. Today, ASEAN works to promote economic growth, peace and cultural exchange in the region.
questions.explanation: Giới thiệu ASEAN (b) → thành lập năm 1967 (a) → Việt Nam gia nhập năm 1995 (c) → vai trò hiện nay (d): theo trình tự thời gian.

Global warming is one of the most serious problems facing our planet today. It (1)______ by the increase of greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. These gases trap heat and make the Earth warmer. (2)______ fossil fuels for electricity and transport is the main source of these gases. Deforestation also makes the problem worse (3)______ trees absorb carbon dioxide. questions.stem:
Read the passage and choose the best answer to the question.

Last summer, Nguyen Minh Anh, a 17-year-old student from Da Nang, spent three weeks in Malaysia as part of a student exchange programme for young people from ASEAN countries. Together with forty other students from across Southeast Asia, she took part in workshops, volunteer projects and cultural activities.

For Minh Anh, the most memorable part of the trip was working in a small village, where the students helped to build a playground and taught English to local children. “At first, communicating was not easy because we came from different countries and spoke different languages,” she said. “But we used English, gestures and lots of smiles, and soon we became close friends.”

The programme also gave the participants opportunities to learn about each other's cultures. On the cultural night, each group introduced its traditional costumes, music and food. Minh Anh and her Vietnamese friends performed a folk song and served spring rolls, which quickly disappeared from the table.

Minh Anh believes that the experience has changed her in many ways. She has become more confident and independent, and she now understands why ASEAN countries need to cooperate to deal with common problems such as poverty and climate change. She hopes that more Vietnamese students will have the chance to join similar programmes in the future.

Which of the following could be the best title for the passage?
options: How to Learn English in Malaysia
questions.explanation: Cả bài kể về chuyến trao đổi học sinh ASEAN đáng nhớ của Minh Anh và những gì em học được.

questions.stem:

The students who joined the ASEAN camp came from many different countries.
options: The students joining the ASEAN camp came from many different countries.
The students joined the ASEAN camp came from many different countries.
The students were joining the ASEAN camp came from many different countries.
The students joined the ASEAN camp coming from many different countries.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động “who joined” → phân từ hiện tại “joining”.

questions.stem:

It is very important to save energy at home.
options: Save energy at home is very important.
Saved energy at home is not important.
Saving energy at home is not important at all.
Saving energy at home is very important.
questions.explanation: “It is + adj + to V” ↔ “V-ing … is + adj” (danh động từ làm chủ ngữ).
